class.name: SfxPlaybackRuntime
class.brief_description: The playback engine of one player.
class.description: What [SfxPlayer] and [SfxPlayer3D] drive. It touches no node - it writes slots that the player copies into its audio nodes. Exposed for tests and tools: create one, [method set_slot_capacity], [method play], [method update] by hand and read [method get_debug_voices]/[method get_debug_slots].

method.name: clear
method.description: Stops everything at once.

method.name: get_clock
method.description: Seconds the runtime has been updated by.

method.name: get_debug_slots
method.description: The slots: stream, start_position, transport, play_serial, volume_db, pitch_scale, playing, position, looping, spatial_override, dirty.

method.name: get_debug_voices
method.description: The voices: slot, instance_id, event_name, clip, stream, automation_name, stream_start_position, stream_end_position, track_adsr_stage, stopping, finish_on_end, creation_order.

method.name: get_event_visualization_state
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.get_event_visualization_state].

method.name: get_instance_ids
method.description: Ids of the instances of [param event_name], oldest first.

method.name: get_next_wake
method.description: Runtime time of the next [method update] with work: [method get_clock] for the next frame, [code]INF[/code] for none.

method.name: get_parameter
method.description: A parameter's value.

method.name: handle_slot_finished
method.description: The node of slot [param slot] reached its stream's end.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.is_playing].

method.name: modulate
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.modulate].

method.name: play
method.description: Starts an instance of [param event].

method.name: play_automation
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.play_automation].

method.name: requires_process
method.description: Whether anything plays or waits.

method.name: sample_automation_curve
method.description: A curve at a parameter value, relative to [param offset].

method.name: sample_automation_fade_out
method.description: An automation clip's fade-out at a parameter value.

method.name: sample_time_curve
method.description: Gain of a time curve [param elapsed] seconds into it (or before its end with [param from_end]).

method.name: seek
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.seek].

method.name: set_bank
method.description: Declares the parameters, derived parameters and triggers of [param bank].

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets a raw parameter; [code]false[/code] when the bank declares none of that name.

method.name: set_parameter_values
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.set_parameter_values].

method.name: set_parameters
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.set_parameters].

method.name: set_slot_capacity
method.description: How many voices it may use.

method.name: stop
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.stop].

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Stops every instance.

method.name: stop_automation
method.description: See [method SfxPlayer.stop_automation].

method.name: stop_event
method.description: Stops the latest playing instance of [param event_name].

method.name: tail_start_position
method.description: Where a drained loop restarts its tail.

method.name: update
method.description: Advances the runtime by [param delta] seconds.
